egress_control_plane.reason: Olmo uses an independent fail-closed, exact-source-IP relay registry.

service_security.vllm_auth: per-run strong bearer loaded from an owner-only file
service_security.sampling_proxy_client_auth: non-secret local placeholder translated to the upstream bearer
service_security.identity_preflight: authenticated health + exact served model + exact checkpoint root

full_run_gate: The checkpoint STABLE marker and exact config architecture must be present.
The authenticated service preflight must report exactly Olmo-0716-step500 at the exact step_500 checkpoint.
The no-thinking pinned-sampling tool-call smoke must pass before any full producer is submitted.
All four endpoint slots must pass exact identity preflight before shards are submitted.
notes: Olmo_0716_step500 is the requested reporting label; prior LiveCodeBench artifacts identify the served model as Olmo-0716-step500.
The checkpoint is a Qwen3.5-family model, not an OLMo architecture.
The 0.6/0.95/top-k-20 anti-loop profile and no-thinking mode match the verified Sushi Qwen3.5 lane and are pinned by the loopback proxy.
A prior 81,920-token evaluation artifact reached a repetitive length stop, so this lane caps output at 32,768 tokens and makes the tool-call smoke a hard launch gate.
Gemini 3.1 Pro is used only for message tagging, not for user simulation.
The Olmo lane uses its own secure egress relay on port 48837 and shares no mutable state with Sushi or Qwen.
